date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(DescTools)
library(reshape2)

df <- read_excel("~/Documents/Experiments/10.16.26 EY121 Lum + Fluor.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Scarlet")

df1 <- read_excel("~/Documents/Experiments/10.16.26 EY121 Lum + Fluor.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Green")

```

```{r Scarlet}
newdf<- df %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarize(across(A1:H5, max)) 

newdf1<- newdf %>%
  slice(seq(from = 1, to = n(), by = 2))
newdf2 <- newdf %>%
  slice(seq(from = 2, to = n(), by = 2))

min <-c(0,20,40,60,80,100,120,140,160,180,200,220,240,260,280,300,320,340,360,380,400,420,440,460,480,500,520,540,560,580,600,620,640,660,680,700,720,740,760,780,800,820,840,860,880,900,920,940,960,980,1000,1020)

i <- cbind(newdf1,min)
j <- cbind(newdf2,min)

```

```{r Scarlet Lum}
colors <- c("Alive" = "steelblue", "Control" = "black", "Dead" = "red", "Delayed Dead"="purple")

p <- ggplot(i, aes(x=min)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A1, color="Delayed Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A3, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A5, color="Alive")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = A7, color="Dead")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = A9, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C1, color="Delayed Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C3, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C5, color="Dead")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = C7, color="Delayed Dead")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = C9, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = E1, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = E3, color="Alive")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = E5, color="Dead")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = E7, color="Alive")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = E9, color="Alive")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = G1, color="Delayed Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G3, color="Delayed Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G5, color="Alive")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = G7, color="Alive")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = G9, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = H1, color="Control")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = H3, color="Control")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = H5, color="Control")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = H7, color="Control")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = H9, color="Control")) +
  labs(title="EY121 Scarlet Lum",
        x ="Time (min)", y = "Luminescence (AU)", color = "Legend")+
    scale_color_manual(values = colors)
p
#ggsave("EY121 SLum.png")


```
